msg: Hello, my wife and I are from Portugal and we are both PADI Open Water, our last dive was about a year ago. We'll be in Cartagena for three nights in February and would like to dive on two different days. What can you offer us?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since your last dives were about a year ago, a refresher is not normally required. From Cartagena, you can choose:

- *Two separate day trips:* 2 guided reef dives each day, returning to Cartagena the same day. Lunch, equipment, boat transfers, park entrance fee and dive insurance are included. - *A 2-day, 5-dive package:* 4 daytime dives plus 1 night dive. You’ll need to stay one night on the Rosario Islands; accommodation isn’t included. Lunch is included on day one only.

The online price includes the 10% website-booking discount. The 5-dive package has an online booking link: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/2-days-5-dives/9?language=en. For two separate day trips, you can select your dates and number of people here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• 5 Dives - 2 days: 392 USD · 436 USD (1.429.000 COP · 1.587.000 COP)

Which option sounds closer to what you have in mind?

msg: The 2-day package sounds great, we'd like that one. Do we need to book the night on the island ourselves? Which hotels would you suggest, and is there anything else we need to do before we book?
reply:
Yes, you’ll need to book the island accommodation yourselves; it isn’t included in the package. We recommend Hotel San Pedro de Majagua or Hotel Cocoliso, where our dive base is, or you can book directly with another nearby hotel with maritime access: Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, or Pao Pao.

Before booking, have your PADI certification cards ready. You’ll also need to complete the insurance form sent with the booking confirmation, and wait at least 18 hours after diving before flying. Bring swimwear, a towel, sunscreen, sunglasses, and comfortable clothes. The package includes four daytime dives over two days, with lunch on day one only.

One last thing so I can give you the right price and link: are you Colombian nationals, or do you have a Colombian *cédula de extranjería* (Colombia's ID card for foreigners)?

msg: We're both Portuguese citizens and we don't have any Colombian ID. Could you send us the link to book the package, please?
reply:
Absolutely! Since you’re both international guests, you can book and pay online by card. Here’s the link for the *5 Dives – 2 days* package: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/2-days-5-dives/9?language=en

You’ll need to arrange your overnight stay on the Rosario Islands separately. Would you like any help with the package details?

🤿 *5 Dives - 2 days*
💰 *392 USD* per person (online rate) · 2 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 5 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch on day 1 and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/2-days-5-dives/9?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.
